title.rendered: Postponed to Sept 20th – Board of Directors Meeting

content.rendered: New Date: The meetings originally scheduled for 9/13/17 have been postponed to 9/20/17. Executive session (closed to the public) begins at 5:15 pm. Bond Work Session begins at 5:45 pm and the Regular Board Meeting begins at 7:00 pm. All meetings are in the Community Room at Edy Ridge Elementary School.
